title: How Stylists Manufacture Cultural Meaning
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: How Stylists Manufacture Cultural Meaning: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: A stylist does not merely arrange clothes. Styling selects, relates, withholds, and frames objects so that a look can enter culture—yet interpretation, authorship, ownership, credit, approval, and compensation must remain separate evidence questions.
frames.alt: Title plate for How Stylists Manufacture Cultural Meaning.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: The sheet demonstrates a contract-shaped network of design, printing, manufacture, advertising, attribution, and distribution—even when the operative agreements are absent from the image.
frames.credit: Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division
frames.alt: A color advertising lithograph presenting Butterick and Company New York fashions for spring and summer 1872.
frames.rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set
frames.treatment: local display and download with attached credit

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · SELECT — What entered the frame—and what was refused?. Record garments, accessories, bodies, props, references, substitutions, exclusions, and the reason each choice altered the proposition. Selection is evidence of judgment, not automatic proof of a legal right.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what entered the frame—and what was refused? within How Stylists Manufacture Cultural Meaning.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · RELATE — What meaning emerged between objects?. Styling works relationally: proportion, sequence, contradiction, repetition, casting, gesture, and context can produce meanings that no isolated garment contains. Cultural specialists should review references drawn from communities whose authority is not held by the commissioning house.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what meaning emerged between objects? within How Stylists Manufacture Cultural Meaning.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · ALLOCATE — Who approved, authored, owned, and was paid?. Attach the brief and call sheet; identify stylist, assistant, designer, photographer, model, producer, hair and makeup; then attach credit, fee, license, approval, archive-copy, and correction terms without assuming they coincide.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who approved, authored, owned, and was paid? within How Stylists Manufacture Cultural Meaning.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · PRESERVE — Can the interpretation be reconstructed?. Keep pulls, returns, alternates, captions, credits, contact sheets where licensed, final selects, usage territories, expiry dates, and participant corrections. Archive the reasoning without republishing restricted material.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can the interpretation be reconstructed? within How Stylists Manufacture Cultural Meaning.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: Treating styling as authorship can erase the designer, photographer, model, hair and makeup teams, assistants, cultural sources, and commissioner; treating it as logistics erases interpretation. The answer is a role-specific record, not a larger heroic claim.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for How Stylists Manufacture Cultural Meaning.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery
